inputs.share_count_basis: 1,543,420,934 FPO at 31-Dec-2025 (note 17, FY2025 annual report). The CSV's 1,506m is the weighted average for EPS, not the closing count. Dilutive securities: 39,999,996 listed options @ A$0.04 (exp 1-Aug-2028) and 600,000 @ A$0.729 (exp 30-Jun-2026, lapsed). At A$0.033 the A$0.04 options are out of the money -> zero treasury-stock dilution in bear/base; in the bull case (IV > A$0.04) they are included (+40.0m shares, +A$1.6m proceeds). 1.5m SARs expired 24-Mar-2026.
inputs.net_debt_note: Cash A$4.259m less lease liabilities A$0.094m at 31-Dec-2025. No borrowings. STALE ANCHOR: nine months old; FY2025 cash burn was ~A$3.7m/yr (opex A$1.0m + advances/E&E A$2.8m), so unraised cash is ~A$1.5m by Sep-2026. The June-2026 half-year report and Appendix 5B quarterlies are not in the folder and the ASX API was unreachable from this build; a 2026 placement is likely (the July-2025 one was A$2.0m at A$0.025 with 1-for-2 free options) and is modelled as the pre-FID raise rather than assumed done.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 reported FCF (A$-2.52m) is corporate overhead plus advances to the JV, NOT a valuation input. Pre-revenue at the consolidated level; the P&L 'revenue' the raw filings show is interest income on cash. No FCF projection of the parent is possible or attempted.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement, share-based payments A$416,196 (FY2024 A$738,789). Immaterial to a risked-NPV model; house and street bases coincide.
inputs.interest_income_note: A$0.185m FY2025 interest on cash; stripped by construction (the model values the project, and cash is added in the bridge).
inputs.jv_structure: Argosy holds 77.5% of Puna Mining S.A. (Rincon Lithium Project, Salta) under the Second Earn-in JV Agreement, earning to 90% on investing US$135m (Phase 3); cumulative USD-designated advances A$30.1m, JV carrying value A$40.0m, E&E A$11.8m — one CGU of ~A$82m book. NOTE: the financial-parser handoff described the stake as ~40.5%; the filings say 77.5% (note 11, both FY2024 and FY2025). The ~40% figure appears in THIS model only as the assumed post-farm-down effective economic share in the base case.
inputs.resource: JORC Total MRE 731,801 t Li2CO3 (Indicated 640,330 t @ 327 mg/L; Inferred 91,471 t @ 352 mg/L), 12-Nov-2024. Hydrogeological model supports 12,000 tpa for up to 45 years. Model uses 25 production years (300 kt LCE, 41% of MRE) with no terminal value.
inputs.independent_expert_fair_value: Argosy's 77.5% interest: A$75.9m at 31-Dec-2024 (normalised comparable-transaction method, supported by yardstick / prospectivity-enhancement multiplier). Internal yardstick update at 31-Dec-2025 reversed A$10.07m of impairment to 'a level conservatively low within the updated valuation range'. This is a market-comps value, not a project DCF; it anchors the bear-case yardstick only.
inputs.lithium_price_assumption: Model prices are long-run REAL US$/t battery-grade lithium carbonate, CIF Asia. Base US$15,000 = the commonly cited incentive price for new brine/DLE supply and below most broker long-run decks (US$18-22k); bull US$17,000; the bear is conditioned on price staying below incentive (no FID). The company's own Dec-2025 impairment update used the S&P Global year-end spot, 'lower than the medium-to-long term forecasted prices'. No live lithium price feed was reachable from this build; the spot at valuation date should be recorded at the next refresh.
inputs.fx_note: Project flows are modelled in real USD (lithium carbonate is USD-priced; Argosy's JV advances are USD-designated) and converted to AUD at AUDUSD 0.7132 (Yahoo AUDUSD=X, 2026-09-21). Statements and quote are both AUD, so no quote-currency conversion is needed.
inputs.balance_sheet_date: 2025-12-31 (FY2025 annual report; file AGY.AX_Annual_FY2026.txt — filenames run one year ahead of the period)
inputs.notes: MODEL: risked project-NPV (sum-of-parts), the folder's SMI.NZ precedent. None of the dcf-methods routing rows fit: Argosy is a pre-revenue single-asset lithium developer whose value is a 77.5% (90% on earn-in) claim on the Rincon 12ktpa project, held in an equity-accounted JV. An owner-FCF DCF is meaningless (every historical FCF is overhead + JV advances); AFFO/residual-income/NAV rows do not apply; the asset-waterfall row is for dead companies and Argosy holds a defined 732kt LCE resource with a demonstrated process route (battery-grade product sold from the 2ktpa plant). Equity = P(funded FID) x Argosy's post-farm-down share of the 12ktpa project NPV + net cash + pre-FID raise - burn - overhead PV, with the no-FID outcome valued on a distressed comparable-transaction yardstick. Scenarios are framed on the FUNDING binary, not growth rates: the project needs ~US$250m (~A$350m, ~7x market cap) that Argosy cannot raise itself (going-concern material uncertainty paragraph, A$4.3m cash), so the realistic development path is a strategic partner farm-down that dilutes Argosy's 77.5% to a carried minority. Base and bull differ on lithium price, timing, RIGI fiscal terms and farm-down terms; the discount rate is the SAME 12% real in both (risk charged once: funding failure sits in the scenario weights, time/execution/country in the rate).

risk_charging_map.time_value_argentina_execution: single 12% real equity discount rate ONLY (same in base and bull)
risk_charging_map.farm_down_dilution: explicit effective-share assumption ONLY (77.5% -> 40% base / 55% bull)
risk_charging_map.pre_fid_survival_funding: explicit share-count dilution ONLY (A$12m @ A$0.03 base; A$6m @ A$0.06 bull; A$5m @ A$0.02 bear)
risk_charging_map.lithium_price: scenario price deck ONLY (US$15k base / US$17k bull / below-incentive bear)
risk_charging_map.capex_overrun: base capex US$250m already sits ~10% above the bull's US$230m engineering-style estimate; no separate stress

inputs.discount_rate_build_up: 12% REAL on real USD flows (~14.5% nominal): US 10y 4.1% + 5.0% ERP x 1.3 beta (lithium developers) = 10.6%; + 2.5% Argentina country premium (sovereign spread ~6-7% x ~0.4 pass-through, mitigated by RIGI and Salta's mining track record); + 1.5% single-asset / construction-ramp premium = 14.6% nominal; less 2.3% US inflation = ~12.3% real, rounded to 12%. Deliberately not a project rate (a lender's DFS would use 8-10% nominal): this is the return an equity holder of a A$50m junior needs. Small-cap illiquidity is NOT added on top because the bear weight already carries the survival risk.
inputs.model_limitations: No published PFS/DFS economics exist for the 12ktpa project (the feasibility is 'progressing toward construction-ready'); capex, opex and ramp are this model's own estimates from peer Puna brine projects and the US$135m earn-in threshold, not company figures. They are the most important unverifiable inputs after lithium price. The Tonopah (Nevada) claystone project is assigned zero value.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGRs (FY2020 A$20.5m -> FY2025 A$86.2m; FY2022 A$94.3m -> FY2025) describe share issuance, a A$69m H1-2024 impairment and a A$10m FY2025 reversal, not a business trajectory. Revenue, EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined (no revenue; FCF negative in every year; EPS sign-flips on non-cash items). No growth rate is selected; PEG is not computable.
historical_growth.notes: Pre-revenue developer. Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income) is negative throughout: FY2021 -2.7, FY2022 -5.7, FY2023 -7.8, FY2024 -4.5, FY2025 -3.1 (A$m). It is exploration/feasibility spend, not a base for projection.

base.scenario: Lithium recovers to the ~US$15k/t incentive price; a strategic partner funds the 12ktpa Rincon build via farm-down; FID 2029, construction 2029-30, first production 2031, nameplate 2033
base.royalty_note: 3% Salta provincial royalty + 4.5% export duty (no RIGI relief assumed)
base.farm_down_note: Partner funds the equity component of ~US$250m capex for ~50-55% of Puna; Argosy carried from 77.5% to ~40% economic interest (vendor ~10%). Equivalent to Argosy keeping 40% of post-capex NPV without contributing capex — a typical outcome for a junior negotiating from a A$50m market cap.
base.terminal_note: Finite 25-year production profile (brine supports 45 years); no terminal value. Years 26-45 and the Exploration Target (186-466 kt) deliberately excluded.

bull.scenario: Lithium sustains ~US$17k/t; partner deal on stronger terms plus RIGI approval (25% tax, export-duty relief); FID 2027, construction 2027-28, first production 2029
bull.royalty_note: 3% Salta royalty + partial export duty (RIGI phases duties out)
bull.price_note: US$17k is still below most long-run broker decks (US$18-22k) and below the 2022 peak (>US$70k). It is a 'sustained recovery' assumption, not a spike.

bear.scenario: No funded FID within the window: lithium stays below incentive, no partner on acceptable terms, feasibility slips; company survives on small placements and the asset is eventually sold or carried at a distressed valuation
bear.components_note: Not zero: a 732kt Indicated-dominant JORC resource in the lithium triangle with a proven process route retains sale/option value. 20% of the independent expert's comparable-transaction value (~A$15m, ~US$15/t LCE attributable) is a distressed-sale level, well below the US$30-150/t range pre-funding brine developers have transacted at. Drip placements at A$0.02 (+250m shares) fund ~1.5 years of overhead. The A$82m CGU book value is treated as ~80% impaired.

base.basis: 100% project, real US$m, unlevered, post-tax; Argosy attributable share applied in the bridge

bull.basis: 100% project, real US$m, unlevered, post-tax; Argosy attributable share applied in the bridge

bear.note: No project flows in the bear case; valued on the distressed asset yardstick.

base.sum_pv_fcf_note: 100% project NPV, real US$m (PV of operating flows less PV of capex)

bull.sum_pv_fcf_note: 100% project NPV, real US$m (PV of operating flows less PV of capex)

entry_price.method_note: Standard TV-at-WACC formula does not apply (no terminal value, finite project). Base and bull entry prices re-run the SAME project flows and bridge at a 15% real discount rate (the required-return table's 15% row therefore equals the base entry price by construction). Bear has no flows: its ~2-year distressed realisation is discounted at 15%/yr.
entry_price.note: Weighted entry A$0.0245 sits 26% BELOW the current A$0.033: at these weights today's price does not clear a 15%/yr hurdle. The expected value is above price (weighted IV A$0.0397) but it is carried almost entirely by the 15% bull outcome — a buyer at A$0.033 is paying for the option, not the base case.

required_return_table.note: Base-scenario A$/share at alternative real equity discount rates; project flows re-discounted, funding structure held constant. 12% row = valuation.base.intrinsic_value; 15% row = entry_price.base.

sensitivity.axes_note: Rows = long-run real lithium carbonate price (US$/t), columns = real equity discount rate (%). Base-scenario structure (40% carried share, 2031 first production, A$12m raise @ A$0.03). Values A$/share, UNWEIGHTED for funding risk. WACC/terminal-growth axes replaced: there is no terminal value and lithium price is the dominant driver (each US$2,000/t = ~A$0.019/share at 12%).

argosy_share_sensitivity.note: Base IV vs post-farm-down effective share (0.775 = no farm-down, Argosy somehow funds its own 90% earn-in without dilution beyond the A$12m modelled — not achievable)

funding_probability_sensitivity.note: Weighted IV (A$) vs P(bear = no FID), base:bull held at 70:30 of the remainder
funding_probability_sensitivity.market_implied_note: At A$0.033 the market prices ~62% probability of the no-FID outcome at these scenario values, versus this model's 50%. The gap is the whole debate: whether a partner shows up before the placements run out.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Framed on the funding binary. NO FUNDED FID 50%: Argosy has A$4.3m cash (Dec-25) against a ~US$250m build, an auditor's material-uncertainty going-concern paragraph, a share price that has fallen 76% in 12 months, a feasibility that is still 'progressing', and a lithium market that only began recovering from a two-year glut in late 2025; peer Puna juniors (Lake, Galan) have spent years failing to close funding. FUNDED 50%, split base 35 / bull 15: the resource is Indicated-dominant and large enough for 12ktpa over 45 years, the process route has produced saleable battery-grade product, Salta and Argentina's RIGI regime are attracting majors (Rio Tinto is building next door at Rincon), and a US$15k incentive price is a consensus long-run level, not a bull call. Bull at 15% because it needs price AND terms AND timing to line up.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC A$0.4m/yr is immaterial: house and street bases coincide and the band collapses (band_position null).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.checks_replaced: model is risked_npv: P/E and EV/EBITDA trip rules do not apply; the historical table is reported for context only

valuation_philosophy.approach: Risked project-NPV (sum-of-parts) for a pre-revenue, single-asset lithium developer with a JV-held project
valuation_philosophy.summary: Argosy has no revenue and no cash flow to discount; its value is a probability-weighted claim on the Rincon 12ktpa lithium carbonate project, which it cannot fund alone. We build the project's real-USD cash flows from stated unit economics (US$15k/t, US$5,800/t all-in cash cost, US$250m capex, 25 years), discount at a 12% real equity rate, give Argosy the ~40% carried share a farm-down would leave it, charge survival placements as dilution, and weight it 50/35/15 no-FID/base/bull. No-FID is worth ~A$0.011 (distressed resource sale); base ~A$0.030; bull ~A$0.159. Weighted A$0.040 vs A$0.033 — modest expected upside, carried by the bull tail, and a 15% hurdle entry of ~A$0.024 below today's price.
valuation_philosophy.why_not_dcf: An owner-FCF DCF needs a margin history and a growth base; Argosy's only 'FCF' is overhead plus advances to an equity-accounted JV. Projecting it would be meaningless.
valuation_philosophy.the_binary: Everything turns on whether a funding partner arrives before the company's placements run out. At A$0.033 the market implies ~62% odds of no-FID at our scenario values; we judge ~50%. The company's own scorecard for that: 12ktpa feasibility to 'construction-ready' in 2026, the 40MW power line into construction, and RIGI. What would move the weights: a signed farm-in/offtake-with-funding (bear falls to ~30%), or a second consecutive year of placements below A$0.03 with no partner (bear rises to 65%+).
valuation_philosophy.what_the_market_is_missing_or_right_abou: Price/unrisked NAV of ~0.4x and EV/t of ~US$46 are ordinary for an unfunded developer. The stock is not obviously mispriced; it is a leveraged option on lithium recovering to its incentive price and on Argosy retaining a meaningful carried interest when it does.
